lane: tectonic-geomorphology: channel steepness (ksn) and knickpoints, not scarp shape
executes: H62-5 (registry/hypotheses.json): the lane at the resolution it requires
hypothesis: The three negative 100 m runs of this lane are a resolution verdict (E2b: Hack exponent ~0 on both 100 m DEMs, 17-31% of cells raised by filling). On the native USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (~10 m) DEM, chi-space steepness steps at channels crossing withheld fault segments are larger than on random same-orientation lines, and strike-concordant knickpoints from >=3 independent drainages place dots on hidden faults better than the controls.
mechanism: Fault-crossing bedrock channels record a step in rock-uplift rate as a step in ksn = dz/dchi (Kirby & Whipple 2012; Perron & Royden 2013). 10 m resolves first-order channels and knickpoint reaches that 100 m smears out.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic resistance contact (hard range-core vs soft Tertiary volcaniclastics / basin fill) -- strike-aligned across drainages exactly like a fault. Secondary: playa/closed-basin base level, ephemeral alluvial-fan reaches, orographic precipitation gradient (Sierra Nevada rain shadow).

substrate.dem: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second current 1x1 degree tiles (public domain), fetched on GitHub-hosted runners, sha256 pinned per tile in data/external/dem10_chi_100m.manifest.json
substrate.fine_grid: 10 m EPSG:32611, nested exactly 10x10 in the 100 m competition pixels
substrate.blocks: 6 x 6 tiling of the 3730 x 3292 grid, 8 km halo, cells whose catchment may leave the block are excluded (edge contamination)

declared_parameters.step_statistic: log((max(ksn_up,0)+0.5)/(max(ksn_dn,0)+0.5)), ksn_up/dn = dz/dchi over 50 x 10 m cells along the main stem upstream / the flow path downstream; winsor log 10
declared_parameters.reduction_to_100m: step := step_max (the steeper-upstream extreme over the uncontaminated, unfilled 10 m channel cells of the pixel) -- same sign convention as H60-A; channel := step defined
declared_parameters.independence: branch signature = global 100 m index of the 10 m cell 500 m downstream of the max-|step| cell
declared_parameters.all_lane_constants: src/gems60/lane.py unchanged (Z_MIN 1.5, N_DRAINAGE_MIN 3, corridor 600 m x 200 m, 18 strike bins, 40 km blockwise z-score, 2 px catalogue buffer)
